_comment: Which upstream artefacts the EDRDG values in data/lexemes.json and data/kanji.json
Superseded 2026-07-28: this file used to describe the jamdict-data 1.5 sdist,
because EDRDG's own hosts were refused by the egress policy. They are reachable
now, the values were re-derived from the licensor's own files, and every field was
re-checked with `import-sources.mjs --verify-fixtures` — which found seven fields
that had drifted since the 2021 redistribution and rewrote them.

upstream.publisher: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group — https://www.edrdg.org
